raw_text: Lmao these 'leaked Dubai photos' are hilarious. I literally made similar ones using the PolitiMeme AI app last week. The app lets you place any politician's face in any setting. Look at the shadows — they're all wrong. And there's the PolitiMeme watermark in the bottom right corner that someone tried to crop out but you can still see part of it. People really will believe anything during election season.
clean_text: Reddit user identifies Dubai photos as AI-generated using PolitiMeme app. Points out incorrect shadows and remnant watermark in bottom right corner that was partially cropped. Notes election season credulity.
